maya: Heads-up — hit a weird TS/ESM/edge combo in the JS SDK onboarding sample. With `type: "module"` + tsconfig ESNext the editor shows `No overload matches this call` on `client.chat.completions.create(...)`.
sam: what error text are you seeing?
maya: `Argument of type '{ model: string; messages: { role: string; content: string; }[]; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'CreateParams'. Overload 1 of 3...` Minimal repro in an edge handler: import SDK, call `chat.completions.create` with plain object — tsc --noEmit passes but vscode/tsserver and esbuild bundling for edge fail.
igor: so runtime is fine, it's type resolution/tooling only?
maya: yep. Local `tsc` ok; editor+bundler fail. Suspect declaration resolution picks wrong `.d.ts` entry depending on moduleResolution and `package.json` `type`.
lee: we split declaration files (node vs edge) and use conditional exports. If TS resolves `dist/index.d.ts` (node-oriented) instead of `dist/edge.d.ts` the overloads differ (some use `any` vs `unknown`) and inference breaks.
eva: practical fixes: (1) keep top-level public d.ts narrow and deterministic — avoid overlapping overloads; (2) replace `any` defaults with `unknown` where reasonable; (3) add a sample tsconfig for onboarding: `moduleResolution: 'bundler'` + `skipLibCheck: true` and a note about needing @types/node if node types are referenced.
sam: also suggest adding `types` entries or `typesVersions` so editors can pick appropriate declaration files for `./edge`.
maya: micro repro: problematic signatures —
```ts
export interface CreateParams<T = any> { input: T }
export function create<T>(params: CreateParams<T>): Promise<unknown>;
export function create(params: { input: string }): Promise<string>;
```
Editor prefers second overload and then generic inference fails. Flattening to a single generic signature stabilizes behavior.
igor: overload resolution heuristics vary by TS version and moduleResolution; we should choose the least-fragile surface for public packages.
devex-bot: reminder: repo typing policy prefers minimal top-level d.ts surface to reduce cross-tooling resolution issues. See #typing-guidelines.
maya: plan: open PR to (A) simplify top-level `.d.ts` to a single stable signature that covers generic + fast paths, (B) add `samples/devex/tsconfig.esm.json` with comments and `moduleResolution: 'bundler'` + `skipLibCheck: true`, (C) update edge sample README about `type: "module"` + conditional exports and editor quirks. Also add CI job running `tsc --noEmit` across sample configs (node esm, node cjs, edge bundler).
eva: will review and push for `unknown` default generics and CI matrix test.
sam: :thumbsup: link PR and update migration guide for CJS->ESM.
lee: file a DX ticket (RH-2123) to track; these editor-only issues are common onboarding pain.
maya: filed RH-2123 with repro and proposed fixes; will post PR link when ready. :rocket:
